title: What the relay learned becomes the next head start.
sub: Every leg's handoff package, open question and final judgment settles into one summary document and FAQs. Each deposit is stamped with the selected model's dimension and written to that corpus; search by meaning or keyword, with a source link on every hit.
search_placeholder: Ask: how do we write titles without repeating ourselves?
empty: No knowledge yet. Finish a relay and choose “Save to knowledge” on the task.
ingest_1: When a relay finishes, pick the packages and open questions on the task to compose a summary and FAQ drafts.
ingest_2: An owner or admin publishes them into retrieval; drafts stay on this page.
ingest_3: Every entry keeps its source task and leg, one click back.
retrieve_1: Search published memories by meaning; keyword when no embeddings are configured.
retrieve_2: Scoped to the current workspace; hits carry similarity and source.
note: Only published entries are retrievable; drafts stay on this page.
deposit_sub: Turn this relay's handoff packages into one summary document and FAQ drafts. Published entries become searchable in the knowledge base.
deposit_preview_failed: Could not compose the knowledge preview
corpus_hint: One entry belongs to one dimension; switching corpora never rewrites old data.
embedding_dialog_sub: Verify a provider key, match its embedding models, and pick the dimension entries will be stamped with.
embedding_key_hint: The key is encrypted on the server; only its last 4 characters are shown.
embedding_dimension_hint: Each entry is stamped with this dimension; other corpora never see it.
embedding_no_profiles: No profile yet. The first one becomes active.
embedding_saved_hint: The active profile is used by new deposits and by agents retrieving memory.
embedding_save_failed: Could not save the embedding model
deposit_profile_hint: Drafts are not embedded; publishing uses the selected profile.
deposit_publish_stamp: {{count}} entries will be stamped {{dims}} dims and written to that corpus.
deposit_profile_missing: No embedding model configured; this deposit stays keyword-only.
deposit_sub_solo: Turn this task's goal, delivery and conclusion into one summary document and one result note. Published entries become searchable in the knowledge base.
completion_relay_title: Keep the way this relay ran.
completion_solo_title: Keep the way this task was done.
completion_relay_desc: Turn the handoff packages into one summary and FAQs; publish them into the current embedding corpus. Optional — finishing the task does not depend on it.
completion_solo_desc: Turn the goal, final delivery and conclusion into one summary and one result note. Optional — finishing the task does not depend on it.
completion_scope: Written with the current embedding model
